clue.text: Efficient assistant in office gets message sent round

explanation.definitionFit: Capable and efficient are synonyms for someone who does the job well.

clue.text: Help root out someone who may be stuck underground after accident?

clue.text: Old religious piece journalist hacked out?

parts.note: ex means former, old
a tract is a religious pamphlet
ED is short for editor, a journalist

clue.text: Someone in boat heard birds

clue.text: Vessel that is used by barber

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a fast sailing ship

clue.text: Having a great inclination to get soaked

definitions.meaning: second meaning: to soak in liquid

clue.text: An occupant of Oxford maybe on the way

clue.text: Italian boss and minister holding on

parts.note: a padre is a chaplain or minister

clue.text: Gangster and policeman work together — and drink

clue.text: Unacceptable behaviour through educational institution — three leaders sacked

clue.text: Nonsense, and vulgar, mostly

parts.note: crude means vulgar

explanation.surface: Rubbish, and coarse rubbish for the most part.

clue.text: Gave an account of missing bishop being caught sight of

parts.note: described means gave an account of

clue.text: Next-door shop's offer for extremely cheap formal attire

parts.note: one dinner jacket
DJ is a dinner jacket
for a cent, a very low price

explanation.surface: A neighbouring store advertises dinner suits at bargain prices.

clue.text: This biryani is sent back — bones in it!

in it says the answer is held within the words that open the clue

explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'bones in it' as the definition, but 'in it' is the signal that the letters lie inside 'This biryani', so the definition is just 'bones'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ribs are the curved bones of the chest, and a meat curry may well contain some.

clue.text: Make homeless crowd turn up ahead of fight

clue.text: Those hoping for job open a paper with ads for teachers

clue.text: Character collecting money for subscription scheme

clue.text: Pagan divinity of moon manifest round end of April

clue.text: Being a yes man presumably to get advancement
